post.description:
Triggers a compliance rollback to re-apply the Ansible baseline.
Requires approval if blast radius is high (spine).

get.description:
Get the onboarding queue status (pending/provisioned/failed) per entry.
Tenant-scoped: non-platform-admins only see switches in their tenant's fabrics.

post.description: Retry provisioning for a failed ZTP discovery record.

patch.description:
Assign a newly-discovered switch to a fabric.
This dynamically calculates and allocates:
- Next available BGP ASN from the fabric global ASN.
- Loopback IP from fabric.loopback_pool.
- VTEP IP from fabric.vtep_pool.
Automatically re-triggers the ZTP baseline provisioning task.

delete.description: Remove a ZTP discovery record. Platform Admin only.

post.description:
4-stage config push pipeline:
Stage 1: Syntax validation (vendor-aware)
Stage 2: Tenant access check
Stage 3: Topology collision + Blast radius calculation
Stage 4: Pre-commit snapshot → Dry-run (validate) or commit (push)
